title: Reset
description: Request and response for the `reset` tool (spec section 5.4): start or restart an episode. Scenario strings are environment-defined; available scenarios MUST be listed in the manifest.

Seed.description: RNG seed for deterministic episodes (REQ-DET-01: same seed + same actions = same observations and hashes)

Scenario.description: Named scenario, checkpoint, or parameterized form (e.g. 'training_base', 'new', 'new:Crashlanded:BorealForest:Randy:Strive:250')

response.description: Either an initial StepResult (with Reward: 0), or {"Status": "Restarting"} for long-running resets — agents then poll `observe` until ready

oneOf.description: Initial StepResult for the new episode

restarting.description: Immediate acknowledgment for long-running resets (full game restarts, checkpoint loads)

Status.description: The environment is restarting; poll `observe` until ready
